analysis:
GE Vernova fell 7.4%, 3.0 points worse than the market's 4.4% decline, tracking closely with AI power and infrastructure peers whose median drop was 7.4%. Headlines point to resetting expectations around AI power demand, with one piece specifically calling out a 9.1% fall tied to AI power expectations and another noting an AI trade selloff hitting industrial stocks more broadly. The remaining items are unrelated comparison pieces and a tokenized stock plan story involving other companies.

The stock's earnings history shows unpredictable reactions: the median move beyond market influence around reports is 2.8%, and beating estimates has led to negative abnormal moves in two of five instances, most recently in October when a 19.9% beat was followed by a 2.6 percentage point decline beyond what the market explained. The company reports again in 83 days on January 27th.
